result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is the promotional banner, where white text sits on a very light green background, making the headline and code instructions nearly unreadable. Minor contrast concerns also apply to some secondary text.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a pale mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast that makes the offer nearly illegible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark text color (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light banner, or darken the banner background so white text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1).

issues.description: The 'Order now' button inside the promo banner uses green text on white, which is fine, but it visually clashes with the low-contrast banner text above it, making the banner hierarchy feel broken/washed out.
issues.suggestion: Once banner text contrast is fixed, ensure the button styling remains consistent with the corrected banner color scheme.

issues.description: Light gray secondary text (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') is fairly low contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color slightly to improve readability while keeping the visual hierarchy.
